main_text.p: quos Spiritus Domini vocat, ad exorientem ibi Solem justitiae, ut in luce ejus ambulemus, & flamma communis, charitatis ac zeli divini, carnis nostrae vincula dirumpat, Spiritus conatus secundet. Habebimus ibi prae oculis mirabilia Dei, qui potenter, ultraque fidem seculorum subse-quentium in jaciendis novae Ecclesiae fundamentis operabitur: horum conspectus, nos rapiet, ad aliam longe, ab ea quam in his sordibus degimus, vitae puritatem. Aperientur tunc oculi nostri, ut videamus quid sit aeternitas, qualis aeternus ille Iudex, quale extremum illud judicium; horum conspectus nobis peccandi terrorem incutiet & nos mundi vanitatem docebit: nec tamen aliter interim de spe nostra gaudebimus,porrectoque collo adventum servatoris nostri anhelantes captabimus, quam si jam e longinquo vocem nos compellantis audiremus, qui nos ad se ascendere & in nubibus obviam procedere juberet. Futurorum bonorum haec certitudo, non patietur nos fluxa praesentium fallacia decipi: sed in metam intentos oculos firmabit, donec decurso stadio, praemium apprehenderimus. Quanta caligo nos quotidie involuat cernimus, dum vitae hujus negociis implicamur: semper idaea illa boni

page.notes: The page number reads "2II" in the scan, transcribed as 211. The word "idaea" is printed as such. "debimus,porrectoque" has no space after the comma in the print and is kept as printed. Words with a printed line-end hyphen are kept with the hyphen. Long s is normalised to s, and u/v and i/j are normalised as the rules require. Possible faint letters in "subse-" and "decurso" were read as shown but are not fully certain.
